title: CRP: Tap Water
description: The drinking water series expansion for the "corpseorigin" mod
body:
# Corpse Origin: Tap Water

> *Survive the thirst in a polluted world.*

---

## 📖 Overview

**Corpse Origin: Tap Water** is an add-on mod for **Corpse Origin** that brings advanced water management to your world. Build pipe networks, supply villages with water troughs (water dispensers), and face the dangers of polluted Corpse Water.

---

## 🎮 Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **💧 Corpse Water** | Polluted water that infects creatures on contact |
| **🔧 Pipe System** | Smart pipe network with automatic fluid transfer |
| **🚰 Water Trough** | Village water dispenser — villagers drink from it automatically |
| **🧪 Longshi Water** | A "special" drink with unexpected side effects |

---

## ⚙️ Tech

- **GeckoLib** — 3D animated water troughs
- **Smart Pipes** — Auto-connect & transfer liquids
- **Persistent Data** — Village placements saved across restarts
- **Network Sync** — Smooth client/server animations

---

## 📦 Dependencies

- **Required**: [Corpse Origin](https://modrinth.com/mod/corpseorigin)
- **API**: GeckoLib
- **Platform**: Minecraft 1.21 NeoForge

---

> ⚠️ *Do not drink the Corpse Water. Seriously.*

**Stay hydrated. Stay alive.** 🧟‍♂️💀
